verdicts.reason: A has a clear, legible headline with the CITRINE wordmark tidily under it, but it puts the CTA first at the far left, so the order runs action → headline → product. Its button text is about 6px and unreadable, the bag is a tiny thumbnail, and the decorative circles are gone, so it looks generic. B keeps the circles and a larger bag, but it squeezes three stacked lines (headline, wordmark, CTA) into 50px. Its CTA is shifted left off the text column, sits against the bottom edge with illegible text, and the headline is smaller. B is more cramped and less aligned, so A wins narrowly.
